en: Black‑and‑white postcard showing a rural landscape with rolling fields and a distant farmhouse. In the center stands a wooden signpost with two arrow‑shaped signs indicating directions to the Netherlands and Germany. A man in early 20th‑century clothing and straw boater hat sits on a bench beside the post, while a boy stands further away in the field. The style and clothing give an old, historical impression.
